newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price - USDA.

text.p: USDA reported on Friday the movements and prices paid on Thursday for imported feeding steers crossing the border from Mexico.

About 1,300 head of mostly 300 to 500-lb steers were imported through Nogales, Arizona, 90 percent of which were previously contracted, the USDA said. Prices ranged between 67 and 77 cents/lb for smaller steers and 62 and 67 cents/lb for the larger heads.
An estimated 2,200 head were imported through Presidio, Texas, with most steers weighing between 300-400 lb and sold at 70 to 80 cents/lb.

At Del Rio, Texas, the USDA said 300 head were sold, not enough to determine an average price of the steers. The feeder steers weighed between 700-800 lb, and were destined for a feedlot in Texas Panhandle.
